newsitem.title: UK: Burford sells Norwich outlet for 10 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Burford sells Norwich outlet for 10 mln stg.

text.p: Burford Holdings Plc said on Monday it had sold a 38,500 square foot retail outlet in Norwich to Scottish Mutual Assurance for 10 million stg in cash.
Burford said the sale reflected an initial yield of 4.96 percent. The outlet is currently let to Burtons on a 25-year lease from 1986 at an annual rent of 510,000 stg.
The property was originally acquired by Burford in December 1995 as part of a 48.75 million stg property portfolio purchased from Scottish Widows.
Burford said the disposal "reflects Burford's strategy of taking advantage of current market conditions to sell smaller properties while the company focuses on larger investments".
